nodes.name: ACK : Unauthorized
nodes.notes: 401 response for invalid/missing webhook token

nodes.name: ACK : Submission Received
nodes.notes: 200 OK acknowledgment to Tally. Confirms submission received.

nodes.name: Form Intake Trigger
nodes.notes:
Tally form webhook : Noir Collective Prototype  
Intake pipeline entry point

nodes.name: Read Agency Slug
nodes.notes: Read Noir CLIENT CONFIG from Airtable. Single row        returned. All pipeline nodes reference this

nodes.name: Code: Parse & Validate Form Data
nodes.notes:
Parse + validate Tally payload.  
Maps to exact Supabase schema.
Hard stops on missing consent, missing required fields, or invalid data types.

nodes.name: Duplicate Application Check
nodes.notes:
Check if email already exists in intake table. 
Returns 0 rows if new applicant. 
Returns 1+ rows if duplicate or reapplication.

nodes.name: IF: New or Returning Applicant
nodes.notes:
TRUE = new applicant, no duplicate found.
FALSE = email or phone exists in system, 
route to cooldown check.

nodes.name: IF: Consent Gate
nodes.notes:
TRUE = both GDPR and AI  consent given. Continue.
FALSE = consent missing. Stop — cannot process.

nodes.name: IF: Minor Flag Check
nodes.notes:
TRUE = applicant is under 18. Check guardian consent before continuing.
FALSE = adult applicant. Continue

parameters.errorMessage: "Minor applicant: guardian fields incomplete or consent not given. Cannot process application

nodes.name: Stop: Minor — Guardian Check Failed
nodes.notes: Fires when minor applicant  has missing guardian fields or guardian consent not given

nodes.name: Code: Generate Batch ID
nodes.notes:
Generates UUID batch_id that  ties all media_forensics rows  to this intake record.
Also counts actual photos submitted.

nodes.name: Write Initial Supabase Row
nodes.notes:
First write to Supabase intake table.
Automaps all parsed form fields.
Excludes _photos (handled separately in R2 upload node)

nodes.name: Switch: Cooldown Check
nodes.notes:
Cooldown Active -reject.
reapplication_eligible_date  is in the future 
Reapplication Allowed: cooldown expired - set flag and continue.

nodes.name: Code: Flatten Photos for Upload
nodes.notes:
Flattens _photos object into individual items — one per photo.
Reads intake_id from Supabase output.
Builds R2 object key per photo.
Marks thumbnail from CLIENT CONFIG.

nodes.name: HTTP: Download Photo from Tally
nodes.notes:
Downloads photo binary from temporary Tally URL. 
 Must complete before URL expires (~1hr after submission).

nodes.name: S3: Upload Photo to R2
nodes.notes:
Uploads photo binary to R2 bucket.
File path = r2_object_key.
Content-Type set from mime_type automatically

parameters.errorMessage: "Photo download failed — Tally URL may have expired.

parameters.content:
# ZONE 1 — INTAKE & VALIDATION
Tally form intake, parsing, duplicate check,
consent gate, minor check, Supabase write,
R2 photo upload, media_forensics write.

nodes.name: IF: Hard Filter Gate
nodes.notes:
TRUE = passed all hard filters.
Continue to Zone 3 Gemini scoring.
FALSE = failed one or more filters.
Update Supabase with fail reason, stop.

parameters.content:
# ZONE 2
**Checks All hard filters set by the Modelling Agency**

nodes.name: Supabase: Update Hard Filter Fail
nodes.notes:
Updates intake row with hard filter fail reason. 
Sets stage to hard_filter_fail, status inactive.

nodes.name: HTTP: Sign R2 URL
nodes.notes: Calls Cloudflare Worker to generate 7-day presigned GET URL for R2 photo.

nodes.name: Supabase: Update Signed URL
nodes.notes: Writes retool_signed_url and retool_url_expires_at to media_forensics.

nodes.name: Supabase: Update Queued Status
nodes.notes: The application is queued to next stage

nodes.name: Call 'noir-collective-france-intake-scoring-photo-check'
nodes.notes:
Async trigger to "noir-collective-france-intake-scoring-photo-check"
Passes intake_id only. Does not wait for completion.
If trigger fails, cron picks up queued record within 10 minutes.
